model: Cirrus SF50 Vision Jet (type-generic, original neutral livery, no registration, no logos)

frame.model_axes: x = FS (m aft of the FAA TCDS A00018CH datum: 89 in ahead of the forward cabin bulkhead), y = butt line (+ starboard), z = height above ground, static on the gear
frame.gltf_axes: X = starboard (model y), Y = up (model z), Z = aft (model x)  (pc12/cad/glb.py to_gl)
frame.gltf_origin: model origin: FS 0 (TCDS datum, 0.900 m ahead of the nose tip [inf]), butt line 0, ground plane
frame.rest_pose: gear down and locked, flaps up, surfaces neutral, cabin / baggage doors closed, nose-gear doors CLOSED in the geometry (their pivot seq 'down' opens them whenever the gear is down)

steps.title: Fuselage
steps.text: One-piece carbon shell lofted from four control lines (crown, keel, half-breadth, max-breadth water line) and a super-ellipse section law; openings cut by signed-distance trims.

steps.title: Glazing
steps.text: Two wrap-around windshield panes with a centre post; door window; starboard egress window; two further cabin windows per side.

steps.title: Doors
steps.text: Clam-shell cabin door (upper half up, lower half down) and the aft baggage door, both on the left.

steps.title: Wing
steps.text: Tapered low wing solved from the 18.18 m2 TCDS area and the 11.796 m span; NACA 23015 -> 23012 [inf]; de-ice boots; tip fairings with nav, strobe and landing lights.

steps.title: Flaps & ailerons
steps.text: Single-slotted flaps (15 / 39 deg, TCDS); ailerons UP 15 / DOWN 11.5 deg (TCDS) with the left trim tab and the right servo tab.

steps.title: V-tail & ventral fins
steps.text: 38 deg V-tail, ruddervators (pitch UP 20 / DOWN 15, yaw +-9 deg, TCDS) with servo / trim tabs; ventral fins carrying the yaw-SAS surfaces.

steps.title: Powerplant
steps.text: Williams FJ33-5A in the dorsal nacelle: heated inlet lip, fan, exhaust mixer.

steps.title: Landing gear
steps.text: Trailing-link mains retract inward with a leg door each; castering nose gear retracts forward between two doors.

steps.title: Cabin
steps.text: Panel, displays, seven seats, lining (seen through the glazing).

steps.title: Systems & details
steps.text: Antennas, AOA vane, EVS camera, pitot probes, TKS spray bars, lights.

pivot_conventions.angles: deg unless noted; door 'open' in rad (pc12 convention); right-handed rotation about 'axis' at 'origin'
pivot_conventions.gear: retract (deg) about axis; mains inward (about +x model / +Z glTF), nose forward (about +y model / +X glTF)
pivot_conventions.gear_door: nose doors: open (deg) with seq 'down' = open whenever the gear is down (AFM Fig 1-1 shows them open)
pivot_conventions.flap: rotation about a drop hinge below the lower surface, max 39 deg, settings 0/15/39 (TCDS); travel = 0
pivot_conventions.aileron: range [-15 UP, +11.5 DOWN] (TCDS), positive = trailing edge down, sign = side
pivot_conventions.ruddervator: kind 'ruddervator': pitchRange [-20 UP, +15 DOWN] (TCDS), side = +1 right / -1 left, yawGain 9 deg (TCDS +-9); positive = TE toward the surface's lower (outboard-down) side; right yaw = right TE down, left TE up
pivot_conventions.tab: gearing x parent deflection; left aileron tab = trim (gearing 0, +-10 deg TCDS); right aileron servo tab gearing -0.5 [inf]; ruddervator tabs gearing -0.4 [inf], range [-7, +18] (TCDS trim UP 7 / DOWN 18; + = TE down)
pivot_conventions.rudder: yaw-SAS surfaces on the ventral fins, range +-15 (TCDS 'Yaw SAS'), positive = TE to starboard
pivot_conventions.door: cabin door upper half opens up (-100 deg), lower half down (+100 deg), baggage door up; open in rad
pivot_conventions.spin: fan about the engine axis (FS +, 4 deg nose-down along the nacelle) [inf]
